The Best Food Advent Calendars of 2026

Jessie Eats

December 1st is almost here, and the best advent calendars need to be grabbed before they sell out. Whether you’re gifting someone else or treating yourself, these are the five I’d buy this year: one for the chili crisp fan, the tinned fish lover, the chocolate devotee, the sweet tooth and the whiskey person..

This post contains affiliate links, which means I may earn a commission at no additional cost to you for purchases made through these links. I only recommend products I’ve personally used and enjoyed. Learn more on my Privacy Policy page.

Fly By Jing 12 Days of Flavor Advent Calendar

For the friend who puts chili crisp on everything. Twelve days of Sichuan sauces, spices and noodles, including the cult Sichuan Chili Crisp, plus a few surprises you can’t buy anywhere else. Some are brand-new flavors and some are old favorites making a comeback.  The 24-day version has already sold out, so I wouldn’t wait on this one.

Buy it! $98

Flaviar Whiskey Advent Calendar

For the whiskey lover on your list. It’s 24 days of whiskey, each one paired with a work of art. Every door holds a 50ml pour from a different distillery, and some are rare enough that this is the easiest way to taste them. It comes with two Glencairn glasses and a tasting booklet. It’s the countdown I’d want for any whiskey lover I know.

Use code JESSIE_EATS for $10 off. 

Buy it! $270

La Maison du Chocolat Vertiges Advent Calendar

Parisian chocolate royalty in an advent calendar. The box opens up like a little Paris building, with 24 windows hiding La Maison du Chocolat’s pralines and ganaches, including two new creations for 2026. It’s as beautiful as it is delicious, and a splurge-worthy countdown for the true chocolate lover. It sells out every year, so order soon.

Buy it! $100

12 Days of Fishwife Advent Calendar

Tinned fish lovers, this one’s for you. It’s Fishwife’s first-ever advent calendar, with 12 surprises inside, including fan favorites like their Smoked Salmon and Sardines with Preserved Lemon, a smoked salmon made with Fly By Jing chili crisp, and a sockeye tin you can only get in this box. There are a few non-fish surprises too. I bought this one as a gift for a friend, so I haven’t opened it, but it showed up fast and I’m already thinking about getting one for myself.

Buy it! $150

Sockerbit Sweet Days of December Swedish Candy Advent Calendar

For the sweet tooth who loves a little Scandi charm. I’m a huge Swedish candy fan, so this is the one I can’t wait to open every day. The box opens like a tiny cabinet with 25 drawers in soft pastels, and each one holds a little mix of Sockerbit’s candies, from gummies to licorice. That’s over two and a half pounds of candy, and it’s pretty enough to leave out all month. It works for kids and adults, and it’s the easiest one on this list to give.

Buy it! $124.99

 

Whichever one you pick, order soon. 

Most of these won’t last until December.
